# Redtekk

> Redtekk is a software development studio based in Novi Sad, Serbia. It designs, builds, and supports custom software: websites, web applications, online stores, and AI features, for clients around the world. The studio is founded and led by engineer David Ranđelović, who works directly on every project.

## Key facts

- Founder and lead engineer: David Ranđelović (https://davidrandjelovic.com)
- Location: Novi Sad, Serbia. Clients worldwide, remote collaboration, English-speaking
- Contact: hello@redtekk.com
- Services: design, development, AI solutions, integrations, optimization, support
- Technology stack: Angular, React, Vue, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Shopify, Stripe, Webflow, Figma, and AI tooling
- Portfolio note: the case studies on the site are projects the founder shipped throughout his career before Redtekk existed (freelance work, his previous company Xelpi-IT, and agency employment). Each case study states this context

- [Services: Optimization](https://redtekk.com/services/optimization): performance, SEO, and conversion improvements
- [Services: Support](https://redtekk.com/services/support): long-term maintenance and improvements after launch
